spec.contract: Acceptance items 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7 and the Errors table; item 4 is LEGION-11's (out of scope, observed but not judged).

1.evidence: Unit: 'binds the API and loads state while the OMP probe is still timing out, launches nothing during the hold, and promotes the queued root and worker once it passes' fetches the bound port over HTTP during the hold (200, state loaded, admission.queue=[issue], no new-window/split-window, startDaemon unresolved), then asserts the promotion (new-window + split-window with --resume) and the two backoff sleeps [10000, 20000]; 'keeps retrying a probe the runner killed past the old bound' asserts sleeps [10000,20000,40000,80000,160000,300000,300000] over 7 kills. Real daemon: see item 7.

2.evidence: Unit: 'refuses to serve an OMP invocation without pi.agents' rejects with 'does not expose pi.agents' after state load, asserts NATS closed and the instance lock released (a second start succeeds); 'does not retry a definitive pi.agents negative' asserts exactly one attempt and no sleep for both the missing marker and a launch-prefix failure; 'refuses to serve an installed pi-legion-envoy that omp does not actually load' covers the plugin probe. Real daemon: LEGION_OMP_PATH -> stand-in printing LEGION_OMP_AGENTS=missing: exit 1, 'error: [legion] Configured OMP invocation does not expose pi.agents: LEGION_OMP_AGENTS=missing', no listener on 19390/19391 afterwards, no tmux server, daemon.lock released; the 3 s-slow variant served /legion/v1/state 200 from +1.5 s until the exit at +4 s, refused after.

3.surface: processes.test.ts (unit) + the real daemon boot with three dead seeded claims
3.evidence: Unit 'a throw while reconnecting one worker claim is logged with its token and leaves that claim alone while every other claim is reconciled': three claims, revokeSessionCapability throws TypeError for the second; asserts kill-pane for %1 and %3 only, claims 1/3 locator cleared with resumeSessionFile preserved, claim 2 locator %2 intact and no resumeSessionFile, exactly one console.error containing 'failed to reconcile worker <token2>' with the thrown error. Real daemon: planner and reviewer claims (sessionId set, sockets absent) each logged '[legion] failed to reconcile worker legion-sjawhar28t-zzl28t-1-<role>: ... TypeError: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'api.revokeSessionCapability')' and kept their locators (GET /state roles hasLocator=true); the tester claim (no sessionId) was retired cleanly (hasLocator=false); boot continued to the probes, the API, and the launches. The 'worker reconnection failed' last-resort line never appeared.

4.evidence: The production TypeError (api.revokeSessionCapability undefined at boot-time reconnect on main's ordering) is exactly what item 3's isolation logged per claim; the dead claims' records were left in place as the spec's item 4 text describes until LEGION-11 lands. Not judged for this PR.

5.evidence: Describes: transient vs definitive probe outcomes with the backoff (10 s doubling to 5 min, unbounded; IMAGE_PROBE_RETRY bounded for legion probe-image), the launch hold (every pane-opening path queues/holds: admit, advancePromotionSweep, launchOrQueue/resumeOrQueueExisting, resurrect, ensureController; stop/kill paths and surviving-pane paths not gated), 'GET /legion/v1/state answers and the durable lane keeps acking' during the probe, the per-claim reconnect isolation with the '[legion] failed to reconcile worker <token>:' line and reconnectRoots' twin, slow_command_timeout_seconds (default 300, its env var, what it budgets, the timedOut shape), and the clone-into-temporary-sibling rule with the 'removing incomplete clone' log and the no-sweep decision. The old 'Before loading state ... probes' claim is gone (zero matches). Boot ordering bullet matches index.ts as read.

rig.wrapper:
#!/bin/sh
# LEGION-28 acceptance-7 launch-prefix wrapper. The daemon prepends this to BOTH boot probes and
# every pane launch (omp_launch_prefix). Probe argv contains `models`; a pane launch (root,
# worker, controller) contains `--mode rpc`.
#   probes : the first HANG_ATTEMPTS attempts hang past the daemon's slow-command budget
#            (`exec sleep 60`, exec so the kill reaches the sleeping process itself); later
#            attempts exec the real launch command unchanged.
#   panes  : inert — the pane opens and stays alive (`exec sleep`), but no OMP session boots, so
#            this scratch daemon never runs a live agent against Dispatch/GitHub.
rig=/tmp/legion28-rig
count_file="$rig/probe.count"
log="$rig/wrapper.log"
HANG_ATTEMPTS="${HANG_ATTEMPTS:-2}"
case " $* " in
  *" --mode rpc "*)
    echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) pane-launch pid=$$ (inert sleep) argv: $*" >>"$log"
    exec sleep 3600
    ;;
esac
n=$(cat "$count_file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
echo $((n + 1)) >"$count_file"
if [ "$n" -lt "$HANG_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
  echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) probe attempt=$((n + 1)) pid=$$ HANG (exec sleep 60) argv: $*" >>"$log"
  exec sleep 60
fi
echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) probe attempt=$((n + 1)) pid=$$ PASS-THROUGH argv: $*" >>"$log"
exec "$@"

#!/bin/sh
# Negative control: an "OMP" that loads the probe extension but reports no pi.agents — the

echo "LEGION_OMP_AGENTS=missing" >&2
exit 0

observations: Load flake (not introduced here): the first full `bun test` in packages/daemon failed 'ProcessManager > dispose() stops every armed boot watchdog's connect-retry loop for good' (a worker-started publication landed between dispose and the assertion) and 'ProcessManager > repeated dead-before-ready cycles escalate to launch-failed' (tree observed status 'dead' mid-transition after windowCount>=2). Neither test name appears in the branch diff; both pass 3/3 standalone and the full rerun was 882 pass / 0 fail; CI's test job is green at the head. Host load average 32–46 during the runs.

scripts/smoke/README.md line 73 still reads 'Startup probes that exact OMP executable for pi.agents; it refuses to start before opening NATS or its API if the probe or any required tool fails.' — stale: NATS and the API now open before the probe passes and a definitive failure closes them (line 86 of the same file already says so). Docs wording; reviewer/implementer to fix.

The daemon emits no log line when it opens a root or controller pane; the launch evidence in item 7 is the wrapper's pane-launch log, the state locators, and the tmux pane list. The plan's recipe mentions 'the root's new-window' in daemon.log, which does not exist. Not a spec requirement.

SIGTERM during the hold (probe hanging on every attempt) kills the process immediately (exit by signal 15; no handler is installed until after the hold — the plan's accepted risk) and leaves daemon.lock with the dead pid; the next start reclaimed the lock and booted normally (97 s, two hung attempts then real probes), promoting the still-queued root. Nothing lost.

The killed real `jj git clone` returned in 1.0 s of a 1 s budget (the SIGTERM reached jj and its git child released the pipes promptly), so the plan's SIGKILL-escalation fast-follow was not needed on this host.
`legion status`/`legion stop <team>` cannot see the daemon during the hold (registry entry written when startDaemon resolves) — the accepted, documented consequence; not exercised.

Item 4 (LEGION-11): the exact production TypeError was reproduced on the real daemon and is now contained per claim; the dead claims' locators remain until LEGION-11 moves the reconnect after the API. Recorded, not judged.
